name: @kanzo-tech/ui
description: Kanzo shared UI — domain-free components over Ark UI and tailwind-variants, themed by tokens.
//deps: `tailwind.css` is compiled by the consumer, but its `@plugin` and `@import` resolve from THIS package's directory — under pnpm a consumer's own install is not visible from here. So what the entry names is a dependency, and `tailwindcss` is a required peer: the typography plugin requires `tailwindcss/plugin`, and it must be the consumer's copy, the one compiling the page.
//size-limit: Budgets OUR shipped code only. `ignore` mirrors the build's `external` list in vite.config.ts — anything externalised resolves from the consumer's node_modules, so counting it here measures the ecosystem, not us; keep the two lists in sync. Barrel measured at 35.27 kB brotlied, budget set just above so real growth trips the gate. The analytics budget (then spelled `charts`) went 4 kB -> 6 kB when the five preset charts became a composable grammar (measured 5.47 kB), then 6 kB -> 60 kB when ChartFilter/ChartSearch/ChartSlider brought Select, Combobox, Input, Field and Slider into the subpath (measured 56.01 kB). That last jump is mostly an artefact of measuring a subpath in isolation: in an app that also imports the root barrel those modules are the same files and dedupe, so the incremental cost is far smaller. The root barrel went 38 kB -> 42 kB (measured 40.66 kB) for the AI-assist compounds: real growth, and growth nobody downloads unless they import it. That is the point -- this gauge measures the WHOLE library, not what a consumer pays. The gauge that measures the latter is 'one component (tree-shaken)' below: Button resolves to 1.08 kB and three of our modules, with no trace of the AI code, so tree-shaking is doing its job. Treat this budget as a change detector for the library's total size and that one as the regression gate for consumer cost. Rebaselined 2026-07-31: analytics measured 66.30 kB against a stale 60 kB budget, so the gate was already red before the colour work touched it -- measured by removing that work's only addition to the subpath (`useThemeTick` reading the palette through the theme context), which moves the figure by 0.03 kB. The growth is somebody else's and is not attributed here, because the minified bundle does not say and a note that guessed would be worse than one that does not: what is recorded is the number and the fact that it predates this branch. Budget set to 68 kB, just above the measurement, so the next real growth trips it again. Rebaselined 2026-08-18: the root barrel went 42 kB -> 42.5 kB (measured 42.12 kB, against 41.54 kB at fb8e5b5) when the core's axes became a generated declaration the barrel carries -- the JSON is 302 B -> 648 B of it, brotlied on its own, and the rest is the one resolution chain. The other three gauges did not move at all, `one component` included, so no consumer of a component pays for it; see `/docs/design/colour` for the four figures and how to re-derive them. Measured again 2026-08-20, and NOT rebaselined: 42.12 kB -> 42.32 kB across one branch that took four modules OUT of the barrel (`complete`, `suggest`, `use-ai` and the `Suggestion` type left for @kanzo-tech/ai) and put two IN (`Diagnostic`, `Questionnaire`). Net +0.20 kB, which is the honest reading and the only one available: the two movements cannot be separated from a single minified bundle, and a note that guessed at the split would be worse than one that says it did not. The AI compounds' arrival is recorded above as 38 -> 42 kB, so their departure is worth about that much and the two new components spent it. Still under the 43 kB gate, so the gate is untouched. Raised 2026-09-30, 43.5 kB -> 44 kB, as a decision (Ángel): the root barrel measured 43.57 kB after four issues from a consumer landed in one day -- `FieldRequiredIndicator`'s `fallback` (+0.13 kB), the `Empty*` parts (+0.20), the `Stat*` compound that replaced `StatTile` and the copied `MetricCard` (+0.25) and the `Gated*` parts (+0.18). Three compounds the library did not have, each with its second call site in that consumer, each replacing code it had copied. `one component (tree-shaken)` did not move (1.26 kB), so no consumer of a component pays for them. Budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it again. Raised 2026-09-30, 44 kB -> 45.5 kB, as a decision (Ángel; branch `feat/form-primitives`): the barrel measured 45.09 kB after `LanguagePicker`, `useAsyncCollection`, `useDebouncedCommit`, the `Field` bridge on `DatePicker` and `SegmentGroup`, `FieldHelper`'s `tone`, `FieldGroup`'s `columns` and `LocaleProvider` landed together for a form generator that was carrying its own copies. `one component (tree-shaken)` did not move (1.26 kB), so no consumer of a component pays for them; analytics went 66.24 -> 67.13 kB and stays under its 68 kB. Raised 2026-09-30, 45.5 kB -> 46.5 kB, as a decision (Ángel; branch `fix/control-heights`): the barrel measured 46.41 kB (45.98 kB before the segmented date-time input and the labelled switch/checkbox/radio rows) against the 45.09 kB the previous raise was set on. What it bought: the shared control height (`lib/control-size.ts`), `DatePicker`'s `granularity` with Ark's segmented `DateInput` bound to the picker and a paste parser, and `DatePickerTimer` bound to the picker. `one component (tree-shaken)` stayed at 1.28 kB and analytics at 67.17 kB (limit 68). Budget set just above the measurement so the next growth trips it again. Raised 2026-10-01, 68 kB -> 89 kB, as a decision (Ángel; branch `feat/analytics-bi-kit`): the analytics subpath measured 88.37 kB against 66.96 kB before the mini BI kit (`Dashboard`, `DashboardFilters`, `DashboardStat`, `ChartCard`, `DetailTable`, `FilterChips`, `useFieldStats`). Most of the +21.4 kB is root-barrel modules the kit composes for the first time on this subpath -- `Menu`, `Popover`, `Select`, `Table`, `Pagination`, `Card`, `Alert`, the `Stat` parts -- which dedupe with the root barrel in any app that imports both, the same isolation artefact recorded for the inputs above. Root barrel and `one component (tree-shaken)` did not move (46.34 kB, 1.29 kB). Raised 2026-10-01, 46.5 kB -> 47 kB, as a decision (Ángel; branch `feat/theme-system`): the barrel measured 46.83 kB once `ThemePicker` and `ThemePreview` (GitHub's Appearance model, a miniature screen per theme) replaced `PreferencesColor`'s light/dark cards. `one component (tree-shaken)` stayed at 1.28 kB. Raised 2026-10-02, analytics 89 kB -> 89.5 kB, as a decision (Ángel), at the merge of v0.19.0 into `release/0.17`: the subpath measured 89.19 kB once v0.19.0's failure model (`onFailure` through every chart part, a thrown value kept whole) met the BI kit's parts. Raised 2026-10-02, 89.5 kB -> 90 kB, as a decision (Ángel; `d5e9e2b`): 89.74 kB once stacked areas densify missing steps with zeros in SQL (`DenseStackMark`) and `DetailTable` formats DATE, TIMESTAMP and TIMESTAMPTZ by their type. Correctness fixes, not features. Raised 2026-10-02, 47 kB -> 47.5 kB, as a decision (Ángel; branch `feat/theme-picker-cards`): 47.20 kB once ThemePicker's swatches preview under manual activation (arrows preview in the card, Enter/Space commits, Escape restores) instead of committing on every arrow, and the cards became the Appearance radio group. Ark's radio group commits on arrow, so the row is hand-rolled; trimming it further grew the brotlied figure. `one component (tree-shaken)` stayed at 1.28 kB and analytics at 89.74 kB. Raised 2026-10-02, 47.5 kB -> 48 kB, as a decision (Ángel; branch `feat/findings`, on v0.24.0): the barrel measured 47.67 kB once `Findings` (`FindingsRoot`, `FindingsTrigger`, `FindingsContent`, `FindingsGroup`, `FindingsGoTo`) landed for its two call sites, a host's job studio and a form generator's validation tally, both of which carried their own copy. `one component (tree-shaken)` stayed at 1.29 kB and analytics at 89.73 kB. Raised 2026-10-02, 48 kB -> 49 kB, as a decision put to the owner (branch `feat/general-moves`): the barrel measured 48.55 kB, up from 47.73 kB, once `Problem` landed for a host's every failure view and the graph docs' failure overlay, both of which wrote the error-to-`Diagnostic` reading by hand. `one component (tree-shaken)` stayed at 1.29 kB and analytics at 88.33 kB. Raised 90 kB -> 100 kB on 2026-10-03 as a decision, for dashboard spec v2: 89.39 kB on feat/discover before it, 99.91 kB after (with Ask merged). The growth is the editor becoming a side sheet: Ark's dialog machine with its focus trap and the Sheet/Dialog parts, the radio-group machine for the kind, mark and width cards, the RelationPicker, the chip filter bar and the spec migration. Less the popover editors, the cards' own editor and the table's column menu that went. Features a reader asked for, not drift. In an app that also imports the root barrel, Sheet and RadioGroup are the same files and dedupe. Raised 49 kB -> 49.5 kB on 2026-10-06 as a decision, for #79: 48.73 kB before it, 49.14 kB after. The growth is `Pref`, `usePref` and `SectionProvider`, and the Ark Select a sourced choice draws as; `@kanzo-tech/graph` lost 0.36 kB in the same change, because GraphLooks and GraphPlacement, which drew those controls by hand, went. Re-gauged 2026-10-06 for block A of 0.31 (#37), as a decision: the analytics gauges now ignore what vite.config.ts externalises, as the root barrel's always did -- @ark-ui/react, lucide-react, @internationalized/date, tailwind-variants, @tanstack/react-table, @kanzo-tech/mosaic and valibot were being counted as ours, so the 100 kB figure measured the ecosystem. Measured on feat/v0.31 (6cbc037) with the new ignore list: analytics 31.22 kB, { Dashboard } 29.88 kB. After block A: 32.31 kB and 31.09 kB (+1.09, +1.21) -- the valibot schema and parseDashboards, relaySelection, the staged recommender, the kind table and the popover editor, the band of figures and the kind cards, less the v1 migration and the side sheet. The root barrel went 48.84 -> 48.93 kB with it on 6cbc037, and measures 49.34 kB once merged over #79's 49.14 kB, under #79's 49.5 kB: the popover body that scrolls, and a theme tick that no longer rebuilds every chart when an overlay locks the scroll or a chunk loads. Limits set just above: 32.5 kB and 31.5 kB. The new { Dashboard } gauge is what a host that draws one dashboard pays; size-limit counts the lazily imported editor in it too, so that a read-only dashboard loads no editor is held by charts/dashboard-layering.test.ts, not by this number. Raised 49.5 kB -> 50 kB on 2026-10-06 as a decision, for #77: `feat/v0.31` measured 49.42 kB after #107, and #77 brings it to 49.51 kB with `CommandDialog`'s `hotkey`, the one `useHotkey` that replaced three listeners, and `CommandInput`'s children. Raised analytics 32.5 kB -> 32.6 kB on 2026-10-07 as a decision put to the owner, for the crossfilter block: 32.31 -> 32.54 kB with `MosaicClients` (Mosaic's `enabled` for a view swapped out) and `FilterChips` showing a bridged clause as its parts. Raised analytics 32.6 kB -> 32.9 kB on 2026-10-07 as a decision put to the owner: 32.54 -> 32.8 kB once `FilterBar` replaced `FilterChips` and a dashboard's filters moved into it through a slot (the bar's readout moved with them). Raised analytics 32.9 kB -> 33.4 kB and one dashboard 31.5 kB -> 31.8 kB on 2026-10-09 as a decision (Ángel; #143): 33.37 and 31.77 kB once `ChartTimeline` landed -- the brushable histogram with its play button and window readout that Cosmograph's Timeline is, playing through the interval's own `publish`, and the dashboard's temporal filter became it (its private `Timeline` went), which is why a host drawing one dashboard pays it too.
